query: select (select count(*) from public.deletion_requests) as rights_requests_total, (select count(*) from public.deletion_requests where status <> 'completed') as rights_requests_open, (select count(*) from public.deletion_requests where status <> 'completed' and requested_at < now()-interval '25 days') as rights_requests_overdue, (select count(*) from storage.objects o where o.bucket_id='submission-photos' and not exists(select 1 from public.photos p where p.storage_path=o.name)) as canonical_orphans, (select count(*) from storage.objects) as storage_objects, (select count(*) from public.contributors) as contributors, (select count(*) from public.submissions) as submissions, (select count(*) from public.photos) as photos, (select count(*) from auth.users) as auth_users, (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as ledger, (select count(*) from public.service_state where capture_open) as capture_open_rows;
